blocks.content: Quiz: You're building a website with multiple pages and you want one place to manage styles across the whole project. Which method fits best?
Tap an option below to answer:
Inline CSS
Incorrect, give it another shot!
Inline styles are tied to one element, get messy fast, and don't scale across pages.
Inline styles are tied to one element, get messy fast, and don't scale across pages.
Internal CSS
Incorrect, give it another shot!
internal CSS applies to a page, but it stays trapped inside that single HTML file.
internal CSS applies to a page, but it stays trapped inside that single HTML file.
External CSS
Correct Answer!
Correct. External CSS keeps HTML clean and lets you reuse the same stylesheet across pages.

Browser default styles
Incorrect, give it another shot!
Default styles come from the browser and aren't a method you control for your design.
